title: Basic Calculator Interface & Addition/Subtraction
user_story: As a user, I want to enter two numbers and select addition or subtraction, so that I can quickly calculate basic sums and differences in my browser.
acceptance_criteria: The page displays input fields for two numbers and buttons for plus (+) and minus (-).
Entering valid numbers and clicking the plus button shows the correct sum on the screen.
Entering valid numbers and clicking the minus button shows the correct difference on the screen.
Entering non-numeric characters triggers a clear error message without breaking the interface.
